title: Weak mixing of triangular billiards with an irrational angle
summary: We prove that the unit-speed billiard flow in every nondegenerate Euclidean triangle with at least one angle irrational relative to π is weakly mixing for normalized Liouville measure. Equivalently, the product of the flow with itself is ergodic.
